candidates.accelerator: Integrated Neural Engine / GPU neural accelerators; proprietary
candidates.notes: Manufacturer-reported 2nm, 6-core CPU, 7-core GPU, +50% memory bandwidth versus A19 Pro, up to +40% GPU versus A19 Pro are vendor claims; external context only, not our reproduced measurements.

candidates.cpu: Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 or MediaTek Dimensity 9500; exact device required
candidates.gpu: Adreno 840 or Mali-G1 Ultra; exact variant and firmware required
candidates.notes: Choose one exact phone and firmware per run. Vendor family names alone do not bind measured results.

candidates.memory: explicit local SRAM and host interface; capacity not set
candidates.notes: Control/bring-up research profile only; no claim of phone performance, production Android readiness or power efficiency.

candidates.cpu: Same exact CVA6 configuration as paired 64-bit candidate
candidates.memory: same local SRAM configuration as paired candidate
candidates.notes: Change one architectural factor at a time. Compare latency, area, clock, transfer and measured board energy; no phone-SOC claim.

candidates.cpu: BOOM out-of-order RISC-V via Chipyard; exact generator/config hash required
candidates.gpu: Vortex v3.0 configurable RISC-V GPGPU research stack; pin exact tag/commit and backend
candidates.memory: explicit cache/SRAM/host transfer model; capacities not preselected
candidates.notes: Research stack to test architecture/tooling; v3.0 documents fixed-function graphics, tensor-core structured sparsity, async transfer and Vulkan/HIP backends, but exact build/backend/target qualification remains required. Not assumed equivalent to a shipping laptop CPU/discrete GPU.

candidates.cpu: Same exact BOOM config as paired 256-bit candidate
candidates.gpu: Vortex v3.0 configurable RISC-V GPGPU research stack; pin exact tag/commit and backend
candidates.memory: same local SRAM and command batching as paired candidate
candidates.notes: Research stack to test architecture/tooling; v3.0 documents fixed-function graphics, tensor-core structured sparsity, async transfer and Vulkan/HIP backends, but exact build/backend/target qualification remains required. Not assumed equivalent to a shipping laptop CPU/discrete GPU.

candidates.cpu: Record exact commercial laptop CPU and full configuration
candidates.gpu: Record exact integrated/discrete GPU and driver
candidates.notes: Run the best available optimized software baseline on the exact machine; do not compare modeled FPGA joules with measured laptop joules.

eda_flow.pcb: KiCad 10.x; schematic, ERC/DRC, layout and output hashes
eda_flow.rtl_simulation: Verilator plus canonical software differential fixtures
eda_flow.formal: supported Yosys/SymbiYosys/SMT flow where appropriate; record exact properties and tool versions
eda_flow.fpga: named board/part, bitstream hash, clock constraints and board observation receipt
eda_flow.asic: LibreLane or OpenROAD Flow Scripts with exact PDK/library/constraints/corners; PPA is technology-specific
eda_flow.orchestration: Rust/Nix manifest and adapters; Symtropy consumes qualified evidence for system/thermal co-design
eda_flow.note: No toolchain is asserted installed or already integrated. Qualification starts with capability probes.

negative_controls.condition: accelerator transfer+dispatch overhead exceeds compute saved
one HDC output differs from frozen BinaryHV oracle
FPGA resources or clock presented as advanced-node ASIC PPA
physical-design result lacks target library/corner identity
simulated power is labeled measured joules/task
CPU/GPU architecture omits required modem RF ISP boot or OS integration
open research GPU is claimed to be commercial-class mobile graphics without matched physical tests
EDA output has no tool/config/source digests
Symtropy predicts a new chassis or firmware from an unqualified reference

claim_ceiling: Candidate definitions only. No CPU/GPU/accelerator performance, energy, area, tapeout, fabricated silicon or product superiority has been measured.

current_benchmark_refs.status: public reference points only; no candidate measured in this fixture

variants.architectural_note: one-entry elastic output; same semantics across widths
balanced adder tree hypothesis; timing/area advantage not measured

comparison_metrics_after_synthesis: logic depth or timing under same constraints
power/energy only under explicit measured boundary
fail_closed_rules: any width/architecture mismatch against reference fails that exact case
one passing variant does not qualify another width or architecture
simulation success is not synthesis/PPA/FPGA/ASIC evidence
do not rank linear versus tree on simulated cycle results alone
